notes.title: 🛎️ Version 1.0.0 is live 🛎️
notes.notes:
The game is in it's best state and everything I wanted for v1.0.0 is finally implemented!
Looking forward to the release next week!

FIXES

 fixed missing uvs of table asset
 fixed some anomaly previews in collection
 fixed a bug where footsteps did not stop
 fixed a bug related to gamepad cancel button
 fixed a bug where menu could be opened in end screen
 fixed a textbox that shouldn't be multi lined
 fixed a bug where anomalies could happen twice in a row


CHANGES

 updated settings screen
 updated privacy notice
 updated controls screen
 updated meshes of two anomalies
 updated subtitle timing
